title: 第11章 托尼斯塔克第12章 方舟反应炉
content_zh:
第11章托尼·斯塔克
“画风的确正常了。”
特斯拉克笑了笑，说道：“boss，我死后，特斯拉克工业应该还在，几十年时间，他们对哨兵机器人肯定有不少改进，你能不能帮我弄到他们的研究资料？”
“没问题，我对哨兵机器人也很有兴趣。”
安德鲁说道，哨兵机器人几乎将变种人杀绝，他自然有兴趣。
特斯拉克很是高兴，他想到一件事，问道：“boss，什么时候建电厂？火山能量太过暴烈，不适合做机器人的能源。”
“不急，有一种新型能源快要诞生。”
安德鲁笑道：“这个时代，同样有天才。”
特斯拉克一脸不服地说道：“是吗？那可要好好见识下了。”
……
现实世界，安德鲁送苏珊回家后，把风魔和霍华德喊来：“你们去一趟旧金山的恶魔岛，那里有一个叫沃辛顿的实验室，你们把他们的研究资料，还有水蛭的鲜血全都给我偷出来。
风魔，你负责潜入，霍华德，你负责电脑部分，有没有问题？”
风魔立刻道：“没问题，小事。”
“当然没问题，我曾经也是个顶级特工。”
霍华德笑道，安德鲁鄙视道：“自称的吧？去吧，尽量不要弄出动静，等偷完沃辛顿实验室，你们去特斯拉克工业逛逛，特斯拉克想要哨兵机器人的最新研究成果。”
“好。”
风魔和霍华德点了点头，乘坐私人飞机前往旧金山。
什么，为什么安德鲁不亲自动手？开什么玩笑，堂堂魔王，怎么可能什么事都亲历亲为？
风魔可以化成无孔不入的风，霍华德是最顶级的科学家，两人联手，很快就弄到安德鲁想要的东西，安德鲁将其送到重生地狱，现在，就等特拉斯克的研究了。
一旦研究成功，安德鲁至少能收获数万失败变种人的灵魂，一本万利。

……
一转眼，时间来到风和日丽的四月，一年一度的顶点奖颁奖礼即将召开，今年获奖的人是公子托尼·斯塔克。
斯塔克集团楼下一个街边茶馆，安德鲁一边喝茶，一边用笔记本电脑查看求职者的履历，很快，他翻到一张熟悉的脸。
“娜塔莉·拉什曼，呵。”
安德鲁摇了摇头，直接点拒绝，并且敲下原因：“长得太不正经，容易影响公司风气。”
安德鲁喝了口茶，暗暗想道：“希望神盾局赶快派人来抓捕我，这样，我的地狱又能多出几个免费员工。”
望着不远处的斯塔克大厦，霍华德神色有些恍惚，他朝安德鲁问道：“boss，为什么跑这来喝茶？”
“带你来见见你儿子，他很喜欢吃楼下的芝士汉堡，经常中午亲自跑下来买，听说这样更好吃。”
安德鲁笑道，他话音未落，小胡子托尼·斯塔克就带着胖胖的保镖哈皮朝汉堡店走去，看他双眼无神，面色苍白的样子，明显昨晚又操劳过度。
霍华德·斯塔克看了托尼·斯塔克一眼，不屑说道：“有什么好看的？丢人现眼，想当年，我一晚上打五个美女，第二天依然精神奕奕。”
“你也一样丢人现眼好不好？”
安德鲁吐槽，他说道：“多见见吧，以后未必还能见得到。”
“什么？”
content_en:
Chapter 11 Tony Stark
"The painting style is indeed normal."
Teslak smiled and said: "Boss, Teslak Industries should still be there after I die. They must have made many improvements to the Sentinel robot over the past few decades. Can you help me get their research information?"
"No problem, I'm also very interested in the sentry robot."
Andrew said that the sentry robots almost killed all mutants, so he was naturally interested.
Teslak was very happy. He thought of something and asked: "Boss, when will the power plant be built? The volcanic energy is too violent and is not suitable for use as energy source for robots."
"Don't worry, a new type of energy is about to be born."
Andrew smiled and said: "In this era, there are also geniuses."
Teslak said with a look of dissatisfaction: "Really? That's going to be a good experience."
…
In the real world, after Andrew sent Susan home, he called Feng Mo and Howard: "You guys go to Alcatraz Island in San Francisco, where there is a laboratory called Worthington, and you steal all their research materials and leech blood for me.
Feng Mo, you are in charge of infiltration, Howard, you are in charge of the computer part, is there any problem? "
Feng Mo immediately said: "No problem, it's a small matter."
"Of course, no problem. I was once a top agent."
Howard laughed, and Andrew said with disdain: "You call yourself that, right? Go ahead and try not to make any noise. After stealing the Worthington Laboratory, you can go to Teslak Industries for a stroll. Teslak wants the latest research results of the Sentinel robot."
"Okay."
Feng Mo and Howard nodded and took a private plane to San Francisco.
What, why didn't Andrew do it himself? Are you kidding me? How could you, the mighty Demon King, do everything yourself?
The wind demon can turn into an all-pervasive wind, and Howard is the top scientist. The two teamed up and quickly got what Andrew wanted. Andrew sent it to rebirth in hell. Now, it's just waiting for Trask's research.
Once the research is successful, Andrew can at least harvest the souls of tens of thousands of failed mutants, making a huge profit.
…
In a blink of an eye, the time has come to a sunny April, and the annual Apex Award Ceremony is about to be held. This year’s winner is the young master Tony Stark.
In a street teahouse downstairs from the Stark Group, Andrew was drinking tea and checking the resumes of job applicants on his laptop. Soon, he saw a familiar face.
"Natalie Rushman, huh."
Andrew shook his head, refused directly, and gave the reason: "He looks too immodest and can easily affect the company's atmosphere."
Andrew took a sip of tea and thought to himself: "I hope SHIELD will send someone to arrest me soon, so that I can have a few more free employees in hell."
Looking at the Stark Tower not far away, Howard looked a little dazed. He asked Andrew: "Boss, why do you come here to drink tea?"
"Bring you here to meet your son. He likes the cheeseburger downstairs very much. He often runs down to buy it himself at noon. I heard it tastes better this way."
Andrew smiled. Before he finished speaking, the mustachioed Tony Stark walked towards the burger restaurant with the fat bodyguard Happy. Seeing his dull eyes and pale face, it was obvious that he had worked too hard last night.
Howard Stark glanced at Tony Stark and said disdainfully: "What's so good about it? It's embarrassing. I think back then, I beat five beauties in one night and I was still energetic the next day."
"Can you be embarrassed as well?"
Andrew complained, he said: "See more, we may not be able to see you again in the future."
"What?"
